name: Kawai Hinako
source:
School: 3rd-year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: a warm-hearted person
Profile: She's a soft, loving and warm person, but she's kind of spacy. She loves shopping by mail because she can flip through the catalogs. She has a younger brother named Mark who always stick to her. She is looking for a person she can depend upon.
